captions.caption: A black screen is displayed at the beginning of the video.
The black screen continues before the main content starts.
Several fighter jets are parked on the deck of an aircraft carrier at sea.
A fighter jet approaches the carrier deck from the left for a landing.
The fighter jet makes contact with the deck as it lands.
The landing jet begins to decelerate on the deck of the USS Carl Vinson.
The jet slows down as it reaches the end of its landing run.
The jet comes to a complete stop on the carrier's flight deck.
Ground crew members are visible near the stationary aircraft.
The jet remains stationary while other aircraft are parked nearby.
The camera captures the activity on the flight deck from a high angle.
Another fighter jet is seen landing on the deck in a similar fashion.
The second jet touches down and starts its braking process.
The jet continues to move along the deck after a successful landing.
The aircraft slows down significantly as it completes its landing.
A third fighter jet approaches and lands on the carrier's deck.
The jet's wheels hit the deck as it begins to stop.
The jet's tailhook catches the arresting cable to assist in braking.
The arresting cable pulls tight as the jet is brought to a halt.
The jet is now fully stopped on the carrier's flight deck.
Crew members in various colored vests walk across the deck.
A wide shot shows multiple jets parked and the landing area.
A fourth jet is captured during its landing sequence on the deck.
The jet touches down and its speed is rapidly reduced.
The jet continues its roll-out on the carrier's surface.
The view from the ship's island shows the jet coming to a stop.
The deck remains busy with personnel and parked aircraft.
The screen fades to black briefly before the next scene.
The black screen continues as the location transitions.
Sailors are working around an E-2 Hawkeye on the USS Theodore Roosevelt.
Crew members in red and green vests perform maintenance tasks.
A white tractor is positioned near the front of the aircraft.
Personnel are seen inspecting the aircraft's landing gear and fuselage.
Close-up of sailors working on the underside of the Hawkeye.
The maintenance crew is busy with their assigned duties.
Sailors interact and coordinate their work on the flight deck.
A crew member in a green vest points to a specific part of the plane.
Maintenance personnel continue their inspection of the aircraft.
Another perspective of the crew working on the Hawkeye's exterior.
Sailors are seen checking various systems on the aircraft.
A sailor in a white jersey is focused on a maintenance task.
The sailor works on a panel located on the side of the aircraft.
Crew members share a light moment while performing their work.
A sailor in a green vest observes the maintenance progress.
The team continues to prepare the E-2 Hawkeye for its next mission.
A close-up shot shows a sailor's hands as they manipulate a part.
Sailors are diligently working on different sections of the plane.
Personnel gather near the aircraft's landing gear for a task.
Maintenance work is ongoing on the lower part of the Hawkeye.
A sailor's hands are shown up close while working on the aircraft.
The sailor uses a tool to perform a specific maintenance action.
Two sailors work together on a component under the fuselage.
Another crew member assists with the maintenance work.
They continue their focused effort on the aircraft's systems.
The sailor in the white jersey reaches into a maintenance hatch.
The maintenance team remains active on the busy flight deck.
A view of the flight deck shows several parked fighter jets.
A sailor in a green vest walks past the parked aircraft.
Another aircraft carrier can be seen far off on the horizon.
Sailors are positioned near the tails of the parked fighter jets.
